class Mentor:
    def __init__(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        self._superMentor = None

    def setName(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getSuperMentor(self):
        return self._superMentor

    def hasSuperMentor(self):
        return self._superMentor is not None

    def setSuperMentor(self, aNewSuperMentor):
        if aNewSuperMentor is None:
            existingSuperMentor = self._superMentor
            self._superMentor = None
            if existingSuperMentor is not None and existingSuperMentor.getSuperMentor() is not None:
                existingSuperMentor.setSuperMentor(None)
            return True
        currentSuperMentor = self._superMentor
        if currentSuperMentor is not None and currentSuperMentor is not aNewSuperMentor:
            currentSuperMentor.setSuperMentor(None)
        self._superMentor = aNewSuperMentor
        existingSuperMentor = aNewSuperMentor.getSuperMentor()
        if existingSuperMentor is not self:
            aNewSuperMentor.setSuperMentor(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._superMentor is not None:
            self._superMentor.setSuperMentor(None)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "name:" + str(self.getName())
                + "]"
                + "\n  superMentor = " + ("null" if self.getSuperMentor() is None else format(id(self.getSuperMentor()), "x")))
